conclusion: The retained single-process native layout consumes approximately 98 percent of the CPU quota. Wider vectors and independent workers cannot use the 255 affinity-visible CPUs because CFS throttles the container near 35 cores.
operational_decision: Use one CUDA context and at most 32 native environment threads. Reduce candidate count and reject weak fits before rollout; do not attempt further width-based scale-up on this instance.
